# AI-augmented agents

> How to hand work from one agent to another, by what a first review of 35 sources and one small run found: the task file, the result file and the checks the lead runs, each principle with its grade of evidence.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension.

## Standard

- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/standard.md): the one-page card to follow, with every principle and its grade
- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository

## Brief: what a task file holds

- [Escalate on a failed check](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/principles/brief/escalate-on-a-failed-check.md): a task file says what happens when its check fails, by default a stronger worker or the lead, never an unchecked retry.
- [List the checks](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/principles/brief/list-the-checks.md): a task file lists the checks that will judge the result, as commands, under four headings in a fixed order: Task, Decided, To find and Checks.
- [Say why it is handed over](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/principles/brief/say-why-handed-over.md): a task file says why this work leaves the lead, with the lead doing it alone as the default.

## Result: what comes back

- [Keep the result untouched](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/principles/result/keep-the-result-untouched.md): the result file stays as the worker wrote it, and the lead's verdict is written in another file that links it.
- [Run the checks at the lead](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/principles/result/run-the-checks-at-the-lead.md): the lead runs the listed checks on every result before using it, at the centre, not delegated to the workers.

## Optional

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/evidence/README.md): one literature review per topic, with the evidence against
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/evidence/bibliography.md): every cited work, once
- [Shapes](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/shapes/README.md): skeletons for kinds of documents
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/decisions/README.md): the choices this repository made, one record each
